title: Finite-Tor reduction and prescribed operation coordinates
statement: For the datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], integral residue Tor makes every finite reduction of a bounded constructible integral input finite Tor. Lift the actual reduction functor, unchanged on objects and arrows, into the full finite-Tor subcategory. Lift the recorded pullback comparison through its full inclusion. Given any tensor-coordinate isomorphisms, define source and target coordinates of the individual compactified and proper projections using only those tensor isomorphisms and the recorded support/direct/pullback comparisons. No unproved existence witness defines an object.
